ig_caption:
Fri, Nov 20: 5,698 deer reported statewide (3,448 antlered, 2,250 antlerless). Season total: 190,459.

Friday's 5,698 new reports were 61% antlered, the lowest share since the opener: it was 74% on Sunday and has fallen each day since (68%, 66%, 61%). Huron added 103 deer, 58% antlerless.
